name: Neft Classroom — Live Route Smoke Manifest
note: Source of truth for the synthetic live-route monitor (scripts/route-monitor.mjs and night-shift module 05). Each route asserts the LIVE site serves the RIGHT app: correct HTTP status AND distinctive content markers present. This is what catches the whole-site-overwrite / curriculum-clobber incident class — a deploy can return 200 while serving foreign or stripped content. Markers are real substrings present in each page's source; add routes as new public surfaces ship.
forbidMarkers: You need to enable JavaScript to run this app

routes.label: Neft · Home portal (apex root)
routes.note: The apex root is NOT this repo's index.html — it is served by the eduwonderlab-home worker (a hand-built Professional/Personal portal). This repo's top-level index.html is served at /classroom instead. Markers match the portal, not the classroom hub.

routes.label: Classroom (legacy link → curriculum hub)
routes.note: Legacy /classroom 301-redirects to /curriculum/ (data/routes.json, deployed 2026-06-25) so the portal's 'Open the original classroom' footer link resolves. Monitor follows the redirect and verifies it lands on the curriculum hub.

routes.label: Aviad practice (personal)
routes.note: Friend's son's summer-readiness practice page. Lives under /personal as intended; monitored so it does not silently break.

routes.label: Curriculum Hub
routes.note: Recurring clobber target — see project_curriculum_clobber_hazard. Both markers must survive.

routes.label: Blood on the River reading hub
Teacher Tools hub (password-gated)
routes.note: Gated by SITE_PASSWORD in functions/_middleware.js. 401 = gate enforced (OK). 200 with right markers = gate disabled (WARN). 200 wrong content / other status = FAIL.
